ideas.pitch: A localized carbon tracking and reporting platform designed for the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill campus sustainability office, calculating scope emissions from student commutes and dining hall waste.
ideas.title: Carolina Campus Carbon Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a concrete measurable impact for the local university community, appealing directly to Chapel Hill judges and sustainability priorities.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered public transit optimization and predictive arrival tool specifically tailored for the Chapel Hill Transit bus system using real-time route data.
ideas.title: TarHeel Transit Guardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves every day on the UNC campus, ensuring immediate relatability and high utility.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined peer and faculty research collaboration matching platform that indexes active labs, ongoing undergraduate studies, and open grants across UNC departments.
ideas.title: ResearchMatch UNC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the academic workflow of students and faculty participating in or judging HackNC in Chapel Hill.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-integrated environmental dashboard that monitors water quality metrics for local Triangle-area water systems using predictive anomaly detection models.
ideas.title: Bull City Bio-Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering with regional relevance to the Research Triangle area's thriving biotech and environmental research sector.

ideas.pitch: A localized AI-driven market intelligence platform that aggregates pitch decks, local incubator cohorts, and funding announcements from the Research Triangle startup ecosystem.
ideas.title: Triangle Startup Dealflow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages local economic context and addresses a clear regional pain point for local entrepreneurs and mentors attending the event.
